A considered approach

Questions about
glucose or blood pressure?

Human hydrogen research is still developing. Results from particular study protocols do not establish what a commercial wellness session will do for an individual.

If you have diabetes, high blood pressure or another medical condition, speak with your treating clinician before trying a session. Continue your prescribed care.

Before you book

A few helpful answers.

Is the session at my home?+
The supplied trial promotion offers a mobile visit. Confirm coverage, travel fees and a suitable location directly with Farra.
How long is the trial?+
The current booking duration has not been confirmed. Ask Farra for the session length and preparation instructions before agreeing an appointment.
Will it lower my blood sugar or blood pressure?+
No result is promised. Research findings vary and cannot be transferred directly to this session. The service does not replace medical care or prescribed medication.
